description: Commission of Election - Notice under the Registration of Electors Act, No. 10 of 2017, that the Supplementary Register of Electors 0 2017
reasoning: This gazette notice specifically deals with electoral processes - the preparation and inspection of a Supplementary Register of Electors for internally displaced Sri Lankan citizens, including procedures for appeals and objections regarding voter registration. It is issued under the Registration of Electors (Special Provisions) Act and involves the Election Commission, making it clearly related to election administration rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
